subject: Affordable Housing Advocacy in Medford
overview: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan spoke with housing advocates about local and statewide housing shortages, zoning reform, and community organizing strategies. The guests highlighted Medford's adoption of inclusionary zoning, the establishment of an municipal affordable housing trust, and data detailing regional affordability challenges.

items.title: Introductions and Favorite Medford Restaurants
items.summary: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan opened the episode with guests Alex Lussenhop, Cassie Fonte, and Roberta Cameron sharing their backgrounds and local dining recommendations.

items.title: Overview of Abundant Housing Massachusetts and Housing Medford
items.summary: Fonte, Lussenhop, and Cameron detailed statewide zoning reform efforts and reviewed Housing Medford's milestones, including the passage of inclusionary zoning, the adoption of a housing production plan, and the creation of a municipal affordable housing trust.

items.title: Civic Engagement and Public Hearing Dynamics
items.summary: Guests discussed navigating opposition at public hearings and emphasized low-barrier ways for residents to participate in local housing advocacy through emails and written testimony.

items.title: Medford Housing Crisis Data and Local Initiatives
items.summary: Cameron outlined regional cost data showing that high home prices and rents exclude large portions of the local workforce, and the panel reviewed municipal resources such as CPA-funded move-in assistance.
